TaskDescription: Intraoperative microelectrode recording (MER) at one depth position during stereotactic deep brain stimulation surgery targeting the subthalamic nucleus (STN) in Parkinson's disease.
iEEGPlacementScheme: Microelectrode trajectory towards the right subthalamic nucleus during DBS surgery; this depth was classified inside the STN (STN-IN) by the neurophysiologists and surgeons (release description).
RecordingDescription: Release file data/Right_lobe/Right_lobe_STN_IN/P10R_STN_IN/03640.mat; depth label (file name) 03640; STN-IN. Channel lengths in samples: [504592, 504592, 504592].
